sources.finding: A provider directly controls and states present API access; EVID-03 permits B for that bounded action. Adding an accessible model option is directional, but no material workflow, rights, realized cost or usage consequence is established: severity +1, not +2. No enterprise audience bonus is added because distinct roles are not independently established.

sources.finding: Present endpoint availability and a directly specified usable no-cost tier support a bounded access option at B under EVID-03.
